risk_note: RV2 by line practice (catalog/** is RV1 in the risk map; both reviews kept). Catalog card entry by price state (D33, BR-PRICE-01 / 03 / 17): one entry for retrieval and active queries; anomalies decided only by union isPriceAnomaly (taobao price_status and the BR-PRICE-01 checks for every platform) before user lookup, rebate quote, item_ref and link registration; retrieval skips the card and records one PRICE_ANOMALY (flat fields, no user, no amounts) without failing the page; active queries fail closed with a typed price_unavailable result (no link, no link_id, no amounts; the card shape waits for the contract sync, TODO to followups F-37); disclaimer price_basis for coupon cards and price_basis.general otherwise. No new amount arithmetic. Written by hand.
